pages.text: Leaves fell in the autumn wind. Water came through the channel to push the waterwheel. But today the wheel turned strangely slowly.
Mumu looked up, worried. "I want to see it spinning fast again."
Dodo nodded. "It's taking an autumn nap. Sing to wake it. I know!"
She stood before it and sang a wake-up song. "Wake up, boom-clap! Wake up, boom-clap!"
The wheel stayed slow. Creeeak, like a yawn.
Dodo sang louder. A leaf drifted onto her head.
Mumu walked along the channel. Leaves piled at its entrance, letting only a trickle through.
With both wings, Mumu lifted out armfuls of leaves. One armful, two, a growing pile.
Water rushed freely! Clunk-a-clunk, the wheel spun fast again.
"It woke! My song must have reached it at last!" Dodo hopped into the leaves, then Mumu too. Leaves fluttered like snow, one landing on each beak.
